english.title: Use trade licence on other than permitted motor vehicle
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of

(A)_[a trade licence]_
(B)_[trade licences]_

used

(C)_[the said licence]_
(D)_[any of the said licences]_

for the purpose of keeping on a public road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), in circumstances other than prescribed by regulation 37 or 38 of and Schedule 6 to the Road Vehicles (Registration and Licensing) Regulations 2002, a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was not being used on that road
english.legislation: Contrary to section 34(1)(c) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes:
(i) See section 47 for restriction on the institution of proceedings.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - for wording see below.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, who was the

(A)_[holder of]_
(B)_[proprietor of **(..SPECIFY..) and the holder of]_

(C)_[a trade licence,]_
(D)_[trade licences,]_

used

(E)_[it]_
(F)_[any of them]_

to keep **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) in circumstances not permitted by the licence. The vehicle was not being used on that road.

other.penalty:
An excise penalty being the greater of either:

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.
or
Five times the amount of duty chargeable in respect of the vehicle concerned.

Fixed Penalty Ticket: Fifty pounds fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
36 months
